title: Kamailio v5.1.10 Released
html:
Kamailio SIP Server v5.1.10 stable is out – a minor release including fixes in code and documentation since v5.1.9. The configuration file and database schema compatibility is preserved, which means you don’t have to change anything to update.

Important note: v5.1.10 is the last planned release in the 5.1 series, marking the end of official maintenance for branch 5.1. Consider to upgrade as soon as possible to 5.2.x or 5.3.x series to ensure you are running supported releases.

Kamailio® v5.1.10 is based on the latest source code of GIT branch 5.1 and it represents the latest stable version. We recommend those running previous 5.1.x or older versions to upgrade. There is no change that has to be done to configuration file or database structure comparing with the previous releases of the v5.1 branch.

Resources for Kamailio version 5.1.10

Source tarballs are available at:

  • https://www.kamailio.org/pub/kamailio/5.1.10/src/

Detailed changelog:

  • https://www.kamailio.org/pub/kamailio/5.1.10/ChangeLog

Download via GIT:

 # git clone https://github.com/kamailio/kamailio kamailio
 # cd kamailio
 # git checkout -b 5.1 origin/5.1

Relevant notes, binaries and packages will be uploaded at:

  • https://www.kamailio.org/pub/kamailio/5.1.10/

Modules’ documentation:

  • https://www.kamailio.org/docs/modules/5.1.x/

What is new in 5.1.x release series is summarized in the announcement of v5.1.0:

  • https://www.kamailio.org/w/kamailio-v5-1-0-release-notes/

Note: the branch 5.1 is an old stable branch. The latest stable branches are now 5.2 and 5.3, at this time with v5.3.2 being the latest stable release. Be aware that you may need to change the configuration files and database structures from 5.1.x to 5.2.x or 5.3.x. See more details about it at:

  • https://www.kamailio.org/w/kamailio-v5-2-0-release-notes/
  • https://www.kamailio.org/w/kamailio-v5-3-0-release-notes/

Do not forget about the next Kamailio World Conference, the 8th edition, April 27-29, 2020, the event will take place again in Berlin, Germany. The first group of speakers should be announced in the near future! Stay tuned!

Thanks for flying Kamailio!
